objects.description: [HermeticWiper](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0697) can compress 32-bit and 64-bit driver files with the Lempel-Ziv algorithm.(Citation: Symantec Ukraine Wipers February 2022)(Citation: Crowdstrike DriveSlayer February 2022)(Citation: Qualys Hermetic Wiper March 2022)
